Test steps / Test data: Submit a leave request for 20 calendar days within a year when the employee has no other leave usage in that year.
Expected result: 201 Created. The request should be accepted because it meets the annual limit.

Test scenario: Submit more than 20 days of leave
Test steps / Test data: Submit a leave request for 21 calendar days within a year when the employee has no other leave usage in that year.
Expected result: 400 Bad Request. The request should be rejected because it exceeds the annual leave limit.

Test steps / Test data: Submit a leave request with the same start_date and end_date.
Expected result: 201 Created. The request should be accepted and count as one leave day.

Test steps / Test data: Create a leave request from 2026-12-10 to 2026-12-12 then submit another request from 2026-12-12 to 2026-12-14 for the same employee.
Expected result: 400 Bad Request. The second request should be rejected because the date ranges overlap.

Test scenario: Submit leave spanning two calendar years
Test steps / Test data: Submit a leave request from 2026-12-30 to 2027-01-03.
Expected result: 201 Created if the employee remains within the annual limit for both years. Leave days should be counted against the corresponding calendar years.

Test scenario: Reject leave after annual limit is reached
Test steps / Test data: Create pending or approved leave requests totaling 20 days in a calendar year then submit an additional leave day in that year.
Expected result: 400 Bad Request. The additional request should be rejected because the annual limit has been reached.
